plain: Hard to understand because it is deep or hidden.

webster.text: Hid; concealed; hence, remote from apprehension; difficult to be comprehended or understood; opposed to what is obvious.

example.quote: To exercise the power of laying taxes, duties, and excises, with discretion, requires something more than an acquaintance with the abstruse parts of the system of finance.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
